itemList.description: Overhauling and servicing of 90 HP C/F Motor No 1by dismantling the cable connection in terminal box by removing the terminal box cover, cleaning the terminal box inside and lugs to remove the scale formation etc complete. Removing the alignment nuts on NDE side of motor earthing bolts, coupling bolts with pump to motor lifting the motor carefully from its position with the help of existing chain pulley block with out disturbing the pump shaft and keeping the same on wooden platform etc complete ---- GST will be paid separately as per govt order

Supply and fixing of suitable electronic timmer with in built 1 Normally close and 1 normally open function contactor using necessary bolts, nuts and washers - 2 Nos. Supply and fixing of suitable bus bar - 1 set. Repair to Vaccum contactor by Re-moving burnt winding of the contactor coil, providing and rewinding using best quality and approved make copper of electrolytic double paper coated wire of suitable gauge. Providing new insulation. Drying out the assembly of core and winding and baking in thermostatic oven at till specialized insulation resistance obtained, removal of moisture from coils. Reassemblying of coil and contactor. after complete repairs for insulation resistance (Note rates are quoted after deducting the Salvages/scrap value from above all iterms).						
 ---- GST will be paid separately as per govt order

Repair and rewinding of R Phase of 90 HP, Reactor No 1 and 2 installed at Sagar WTP by dismantling the incoming and out going cables of reactor and loading faulty reactor with active parts/accessories from pumping station to vehicle without affecting other installations. Safe Transportation of auto transformer with active parts and its accessories from pumping station to work shop. Unloading of faulty transformer with active arts/accessories at work shop. Dismantling faulty auto transformer at work shop, conducting preliminary tests. Re-moving burnt "R" phases limb winding cleaning the core, providing and rewinding "R" phases using best quality and approved make copper of electrolytic double paper coated wire of suitable gauge. Drying out the assembly of core and winding and baking in thermostatic oven at the temperature of 120 degree till specialized insulation resistance obtained, removal of moisture from core and winding. Reassemblying of core and winding. Repairs for insulation resistance, ratio of all taps, short circuit magnetic balance of the core, magnetizing the KV for a voltage of 10% above the rated voltage for a period of 1 minute including the voltage from LV side. Loading, Transportation of repaired reactor from work shop to pumping station. Erection and Commissioning of reactor including connections incoming and out going cables etc., complete and giving satisfactory running etc. complete. (Note rates are quoted after deducting the Salvages/scrap value from above all iterms)						
 ---- GST will be paid separately as per govt order
